note: Powder River County (MT) publishes no zoning district layer as an ArcGIS REST or other queryable service; arcgis search for zoning in the county box returned none. The only Powder River County zoning-related items found are a third-party parcel download (dynamospatial) and a commercial plat viewer, neither official. The Town of Broadus (county seat) has a 2011-01 Zoning Ordinance as a PDF text document with no zoning map or GIS service linked. The county's planning board page and departments page link no zoning GIS.
